name: Long Distance Strategies
description: Provides communication routines, visit planning frameworks, shared activity ideas, and time zone management strategies for maintaining long-distance relationships. Produces structured connection plans with daily, weekly, and monthly rituals. Use when the user asks about maintaining a long-distance relationship, communication strategies for distance, planning visits, or shared activities when apart. Do NOT use for assessing relationship health, deciding whether to pursue a long-distance relationship, or replacing couples therapy.
